text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—Just how far into the distance
does this darkness go?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haaah... hic, haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...The reason I started running
was because right before my eyes was a back I wanted to chase."

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: “――Come at me! Brian!!”

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I just ran with all my heart, chasing after her.
Completely consumed by the desire to catch up—!"

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
"Breaking news. Biwa Hayahide, who was
competing in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—"

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
"Having suffered an injury to her left leg,
it was announced that 'all future race plans
have been wiped clean.'"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Sis?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Where are you going?
You're coming back, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
................
...Why aren't you saying anything?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Why do you look so lonely!
Why—...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Please don't go...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...My throat is parched.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how much I run, and run, and run!
This thirst in my throat is never quenched."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Ouch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It hurts.

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news. Narita Brian has announced
that she will withdraw from the Tenno Sho (Spring)
due to an injury.

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text: "After the Hanshin Daishoten, she felt discomfort in her lower back, and detailed examinations revealed an abnormality in her hip joint."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haaah... phoo, haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Still.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —It can't end yet.

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
And now for our next topic.
Can the "Monster" Narita Brian make a comeback?
She has officially announced her entry into the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even if this darkness continues.
Even if my body rejects my running.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Dammit, dammit, dammit...! Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAAARGH!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Why am I struggling?
In darkness like this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Even though that back has vanished somewhere far away.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: When even I can no longer see myself.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here it is, the Japan Cup!
Elites from home and abroad
have now gathered here at Tokyo Racecourse!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghh, Narita Brian!
You can run! I know you can!!
Blow away that slump from the Tenno Sho Autumn!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Please... Let me see that running form one more time—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …………Ama-san, huh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "I was planning on traveling back and forth between America and here more often for the tour, but I decided to wrap things up early this year."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I might head off for more training next year, but... I decided to dedicate this entire year to competing against you, so I kept conditioning myself here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is that injury of yours
still hurting?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "I kept up with your news even while I was racing abroad. But that run of yours at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey! If you're having trouble, talk to me!
You've got me, and everyone around you—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This is my problem.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, if you want to silence the chatter,
you just have to shut them up with those legs you say have gotten stronger."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the underground tunnel before the Japan Cup.
Just as I was doing a final strategy check
with Sakura Laurel—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing right where Sakura Laurel was looking
was none other than Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...May I go talk to her one last time?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have already finished briefing Sakura Laurel
on the race's characteristics
and our projected race development.
choice_data_list: I don't mind at all. All that's left is for you to run.
I don't mind! All that's left is for you to run!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Well then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Brian-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Sakura Laurel.
Your classmate, and from your same generation.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And I'll be the Umamusume running ahead of you,
becoming the one you aspire to be.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Under normal circumstances, I don't think
I would have run in today's
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even reaching this point should have been an ordeal for me.
Because my legs were so fragile, I never knew when they might break.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The teachers and friends at Victory Club,
and the hospital doctor all protected my legs with such care.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"The person who promised to share my dream with me,
nurtured and cherished it dearly."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Because ahead of me was
that "inspiring back" I wanted to chase.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's thanks to so many twists of fate
that I was able to make it this far. ...That's why,

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The path that lay beyond the light you were meant to show...
I'll show it to you instead.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'll become someone you can look up to.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, I'm counting on you today,
Brian-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...If you claim that this is the threshold of winter.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show you the spring that's waiting in the future.
Just for you."
